penalty_rate_basis.text: The chance that one report of a personal data breach to the ICO draws an ICO monetary penalty. Counted: 20 ICO monetary penalties under UK GDPR or the Data Protection Act 2018, each for a failure to keep personal data secure or for a personal data breach, over 95,466 breach reports of every kind the ICO received, in ICO financial years 2018/19 to 2025/26. Both sides are the ICO's own published records: the penalties from its enforcement pages and notices, live and in the UK Government Web Archive, and the reports from its annual reports. They were read for the research on 2026-11-14 and 2026-11-15 and not read again for this publication. The interval, 0.000128 to 0.000400, is the envelope of exact 95% Poisson intervals over four windows with the same years in both. A check found the rate and interval hold, and the top edge soft: the Poisson limits of variants that break the same-years rule, or add 1998 Act penalties, reach about 0.00053. It is a rate over every report of every kind, and most reports are small. Its own researcher calls it a floor, too low for a serious breach by an amount the method cannot state. Two other counts give higher rates: cyber reports only, 0.000529, and serious commercial cyber breaches, 0.0038. All three are recorded in the hub repository under .scratch/distil/penalty-rate/ at commit d1aebbb. The owner of this estate chose this count, at its point value, on 2026-11-15, as .scratch/distil/DECISIONS.md at that commit records.

fines.litigation: an ICO monetary penalty notice under DPA 2018 s155 is the penalty IMPOSED, not a notice of intent: the GBP 183,390,000 notice of intent of 2019 was reduced to this figure before it was issued. No adverse litigation about it is known to this repository, and NO tribunal or court register was read.

the ICO imposed GBP 7,552,800 on 2022-05-23. It was set aside in 2023, reinstated on jurisdiction by the Upper Tribunal in October 2025 and remitted for the substantive appeal, and it has NEVER BEEN COLLECTED, so the substantive challenge is undecided and there is no collected figure: it does not price. fines.source: ICO monetary penalty notice, 17 Dec 2019; reduced by the First-tier Tribunal in 2021; further appeals dismissed by the Upper Tribunal in 2023 and the Court of Appeal in 2024
fines.litigation: the GBP 275,000 notice of 2019-12-17 was reduced to GBP 92,000 by the First-tier Tribunal in 2021 (EA/2020/0065/V); the Upper Tribunal in 2023 ([2023] UKUT 132 (AAC)) and the Court of Appeal in 2024 ([2024] EWCA Civ 1515) dismissed the pharmacy's further appeals, so that figure was left in place. BASIS: the notice itself, in the UK Government Web Archive, and those three decisions, read on 2026-11-15. Up to version 5.1.0 this text dated the notice 2019-12-12; the notice, the three decisions and the ICO's own 2019 pages do not give that date.
